steps.title: Place reservoirs and plates
steps.instruction: Place the five reservoirs and the pre‑labelled 96‑well plates inside the Opentron deck.

steps.title: Add 80 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Using the Opentron robot, dispense 1 mL of 80 % ethanol from the reservoir into every well of each of the two 96‑well plates labeled “80% Ethanol”.

steps.title: Add wash buffer
steps.instruction: Using the Opentron robot, dispense 1 mL of wash buffer from the reservoir into every well of each of the two 96‑well plates labeled “Wash buffer”.

steps.title: Add binding reagents
steps.instruction: Using the Opentron robot, add 550 µL of viral binding solution and 50 µL of binding beads to each well of the Sample plate.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Using the Opentron robot, dispense 50 µL of elution buffer into each well of the 96‑well plate labeled “Elution”.
